Screen: Alat → <b>Alarm</b>: the alarm list (tap one, then HAPUS twice to delete it) and + TAMBAH (add): set the hour and minute with + and - (hold to go fast), choose Ulang (repeat: once, every day, Monday-Friday, Saturday-Sunday) and Bunyi (sound: voice, radio, SD song). When an alarm goes off, the screen shows TUNDA 5 MENIT (snooze 5 minutes) and MATIKAN (turn off); if nobody touches it, the reminder repeats every 15 seconds (at most 5 times) and the screen returns to Beranda after 3 minutes

three tabs. Timer: 1-99 minutes, hold -1/+1 to change it quickly, and the alarm screen appears when time is up. Pomodoro: 25 minutes of focus, 5 minutes of rest, and a 15-minute rest every 4th round; Zond announces each change. Stopwatch: with a PUTARAN (lap) button. All three keep running when you close the page
add, subtract, multiply, divide, and percent; multiplication and division come first (2+3x4 = 14). The running result shows at the top. Numbers use the Indonesian format: 1.234,5
Screen: Alat → Senter (flashlight), or Telegram /senter on / /senter off

turns on the flash LED on the ESP32-CAM (the robot head). It turns itself off after 5 minutes so the LED does not overheat. The LAYAR PUTIH (white screen) button makes the whole screen white as a backup light
Screen: Alat → Penerjemah (translator), or Telegram /terjemah jepang selamat pagi

tap BICARA and say a sentence in Indonesian; the AI translates it and Zond speaks it with the accent of the target language. Languages: English, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin, Korean, Javanese, Sasak. The screen shows the pronunciation in Latin letters because the screen font has no Arabic, Japanese, or Chinese characters; Telegram shows both. The AI knows Sasak less well and it is spoken with an Indonesian accent, so results may be less accurate
Screen: Alat → Catatan (notes), the web panel (Catatan section), or Telegram /catat beli susu

a to-do list of up to 20 lines, kept when the robot is switched off. On the screen: + DENGAN SUARA (by voice), then say the note; tap a line to mark it done (green), and BERSIHKAN (clear) deletes the finished ones. Telegram: /catat (list), /catat selesai 2, /catat hapus 2, /catat hapus selesai

REKAM (record), then speak; SELESAI (done) stops it (1 minute at most). Recordings are saved as WAV on the SD card in the /rekaman folder, named by date and time. Tap a recording to play it, HAPUS twice to delete it. One minute is about 1.9 MB

FOTO takes a picture with the robot camera (640x480) and saves it on the SD card in the /foto folder. The < and > buttons move between photos (newest first), KIRIM sends it to Telegram, HAPUS twice deletes it. You can also copy the photos from the card on a laptop
Recordings sound quiet or hissy: the INMP441 microphone picks up best from 30-50 cm away, with its small hole facing your mouth. A faint hiss is microphone noise, normal for this module.
The gallery says "Foto tidak bisa dibaca" (photo cannot be read): the file in /foto is not a JPEG from the robot camera, or it is larger than 600 KB. Photos taken by Zond itself can always be read.
